tools.name: get_logo
tools.description: Look up the logo of a company by its domain (stripe.com). Returns a stable URL, the brand name, a ready img tag and the brand page. variant: base (original colours), white, black, grey or dark (for dark backgrounds); recolour variants exist for SVG only. format: svg (default) or png. tools.name: search_logos
tools.description: Find brands in the catalog by company name or domain (exact and close matches). Returns up to 8 matches, each with domain, name and logo URL. Use it when you know the name but not the domain.

tools.name: get_favicon
tools.description: Get the favicon (square icon) of a company by domain. Returns the scalable SVG URL and a PNG URL at the nearest standard size (128, 256, 512 or 1024). If the brand is not in the catalog, found is false.
